options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

options.name: Locations Per Weather
options.doc: The total number of locations per type of weather. (There are 3 weather types)
options.doc_html: The total number of locations per type of weather. (There are 3 weather types)

options.name: Start Distance
options.doc:
The distance to the closest BK at the start.
Each 'New Location' upgrade opens a location halfway between your house and the current closest location.
options.doc_html: The distance to the closest BK at the start. Each 'New Location' upgrade opens a location halfway between your house and the current closest location.

options.name: Speed Per Upgrade
options.doc:
The amount of speed gained for each shoe upgrade.
Snow boots give half this speed in the snow.
options.doc_html: The amount of speed gained for each shoe upgrade. Snow boots give half this speed in the snow.

options.name: Extra Filler Rate
options.doc:
This percent of shoe/boot upgrades will attempt to be turned into filler.
The number of upgrades will not be reduced below the amount logically required.
options.doc_html: This percent of shoe/boot upgrades will attempt to be turned into filler. The number of upgrades will not be reduced below the amount logically required.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
If enabled, when another player with DeathLink enabled dies, you will die as well.
BK Simulator does not *send* DeathLinks, only receives them.
options.doc_html: If enabled, when another player with DeathLink enabled dies, you will die as well. BK Simulator does not send DeathLinks, only receives them.

options.name: Death Link Group
options.doc:
If DeathLink is enabled, only players with a matching Group name will be linked.
An empty group name will link with games that don't support groups.
options.doc_html: If DeathLink is enabled, only players with a matching Group name will be linked. An empty group name will link with games that don't support groups.
